Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Anastasia of Serbia’s husband as Stefan Prvovenčani (her son) despite the search result clearly stating her husband was Stefan Nemanja. This wrong identification caused all subsequent searches to target the wrong person and led to an incorrect final answer (burial site of Stefan Prvovenčani instead of the place of death of Stefan Nemanja).
